title: Unify literature-search routing without prompt coupling
description: Expands literature-search into a unified routing skill that handles specific paper lookup, fuzzy paper lookup, topic literature search, systematic review, and corpus reading without relying on AGENTS.md to decide tool order.
changes: Introduce an intent matrix for specific paper lookup, fuzzy paper lookup, topic search, systematic review, and corpus reading.
Keep concrete paper lookup web-first at the skill level while delegating the actual web search to native websearch/webfetch.
Allow arc_search_literature as academic metadata enrichment and topic search, instead of treating it as a hard fallback rejection path.
Keep retrieval policy versioned in the skill rather than in AGENTS.md.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous narrower literature-search guidance.
